title: 28 September - Compassionate Citizens
summary: On 28th September, 2026, the Interact Club of Bharda New High School and Junior College organised an engaging session on “Compassionate Citizen” for students of Classes III to VIII.
description:
On 28th September, 2026, the Interact Club of Bharda New High School and Junior College organised an engaging session on “Compassionate Citizen” for students of Classes III to VIII. The session was conducted by Mrs. Meenakshi Narang from PETA. The Compassionate Citizen
Programme encourages children to be kind, caring and respectful towards animals, people and the environment. Students learnt that animals are
living beings capable of experiencing feelings and emotions, and were encouraged to develop empathy, compassion and a sense of responsibility
towards all living beings. The session also highlighted the importance of helping others, treating animals with kindness and protecting the
environment. Through an interactive presentation, students were encouraged to become more compassionate and responsible citizens
and contribute towards building a kinder and more caring society.
